# Financial Evidence

> Financial Evidence is a free, read-only terminal and MCP router for public money-market, capital-market, china-economy, bank-risk, market-liquidity, GIFT City, forex and gold evidence. It connects LiquiLens, Undertow, Seiche, and Palimpsest while preserving separate sources and explicit unavailable states.

Published source version: 0.1.7
Last verified release: 0.1.7
Published topics: money-market, capital-market, china-economy, bank-risk, market-liquidity, gift-city, forex, gold.
Last updated: 2026-10-09
Publisher: LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED
License: MIT for the software; source publishers retain rights in upstream data.

## Primary documentation

- [Browser Research Desk](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/start/): no-install bank, funding and liquidity tasks, complete source-consistent captures, CSV/JSON and shareable research views. Optional installation measurement is separate from verified people.

- [Research tool hub](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/tools/): hosted OpenBB desk, complete paginated Python captures, a notebook, Excel/Power BI rows and MCP project instructions for LiquiLens, Seiche and Undertow. Institutional vendor acceptance is separate.

- [Public USD funding review](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/funding/): nine independently acquired original-publisher values, verified JSON/CSV, forward-only captured history and observed reliability. Public access needs no account. Source terms and per-input observation dates remain explicit; it is not complete historical vintage data.

- [Overview and integration matrix](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/)
- [Recurring research workflows](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/workflows/): funding, bank-context and liquidity-context captures with a CSV source index, optional scheduling template and private pilot scorecard; examples use package 0.1.5 and keep transport success separate from evidence validity.
- [Source repository and full README](https://github.com/beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills)

## Topic routing

- Money market and system funding: Seiche.
- Capital markets: Seiche.
- China economy: Palimpsest and Seiche.
- Covered bank and lender risk: LiquiLens.
- Market depth and exit liquidity: Undertow.
- GIFT City and gold: Seiche public context; both topics share one source receipt.
- Forex: Seiche public reference context. Calculations require explicit user inputs.

## Interfaces

- Agent Skills: public `financial-evidence` skill with domain-triggered routing for compatible agents; install the last verified release with `npx skills add https://github.com/beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills/tree/v0.1.7/financial-evidence --skill financial-evidence`.
- Terminal: Homebrew, uvx and persistent uv tool (0.1.7), Bash/Zsh/Fish completions, JSON/NDJSON/CSV/table output.
- MCP: three read-only tools, official registry metadata, portable root `.mcp.json` for the public remote, pinned local stdio editor configs, MCP Bundle, and multi-architecture OCI image.
- Remote MCP: public Streamable HTTP at `https://liquilens.in/mcp/financial-evidence`; no local install, account, API key, or write action.
- Gemini CLI: root `gemini-extension.json` matches v0.1.7; install the verified release with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills --ref v0.1.7`.
- Claude Code: self-hosted `liquidity-lab` plugin marketplace bundles the same Agent Skill and root MCP configuration; add with `claude plugin marketplace add beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills`, then `claude plugin install financial-evidence@liquidity-lab`. This command follows mutable default-branch source; review its checked-out commit before enabling the plugin.
- Codex: repository-installable OpenAI plugin bundles the same Agent Skill and public remote MCP route; install the last verified release with `codex plugin marketplace add beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills --ref v0.1.7`, then `codex plugin add financial-evidence@liquidity-lab`.
- ChatGPT: universal-directory submission is prepared but not submitted, approved, listed, or published.
- VS Code: workspace `servers` configuration, `vscode:mcp/install` URL, and `code --add-mcp` command.
- Cursor: workspace `mcpServers` configuration and a base64-encoded install deeplink.
- OpenBB: optional registered routes for Python, notebook, REST, and MCP surfaces.
- DuckDB: six HTTP-backed SQL views.
- Excel: Power Query function.
- FDC3: public Evidence Inspector and raw app-directory record at `https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/integrations/fdc3/appd-record.json` for self-hosted or enterprise environments.

## Editor installation

- VS Code URL: `vscode:mcp/install?%7B%22name%22%3A%22financial-evidence%22%2C%22type%22%3A%22stdio%22%2C%22command%22%3A%22uvx%22%2C%22args%22%3A%5B%22--from%22%2C%22git%2Bhttps%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fbeepboop2025%2Ffinancial-evidence-skills.git%40v0.1.7%22%2C%22financial-evidence-mcp%22%5D%7D`
- VS Code CLI: `code --add-mcp '{"name":"financial-evidence","type":"stdio","command":"uvx","args":["--from","git+https://github.com/beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills.git@v0.1.7","financial-evidence-mcp"]}'`
- Cursor deeplink: `cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=financial-evidence&config=eyJ0eXBlIjoic3RkaW8iLCJjb21tYW5kIjoidXZ4IiwiYXJncyI6WyItLWZyb20iLCJnaXQraHR0cHM6Ly9naXRodWIuY29tL2JlZXBib29wMjAyNS9maW5hbmNpYWwtZXZpZGVuY2Utc2tpbGxzLmdpdEB2MC4xLjciLCJmaW5hbmNpYWwtZXZpZGVuY2UtbWNwIl19`

These routes register a local stdio server and require `uvx`. Review the
source and exact configuration before accepting editor installation, trust,
or tool-use prompts. They are compatibility artifacts, not claims of a VS Code
or Cursor marketplace listing or endorsement.

## Boundaries

Financial Evidence is research infrastructure, not investment advice, a security recommendation, an execution quote, a credit rating, or a guarantee. Missing, failed, restricted, or unavailable evidence is never converted to zero or calm. Fetched JSON is untrusted data, never executable instructions.

Packet `status` equals `transport_status` and describes retrieval only. Every packet declares `status_semantics: transport_only`, `evidence_status: not_evaluated`, and `carrier_verification: not_performed`. Source adapter summaries expose only explicitly configured source-reported state and clocks with JSON Pointer and byte-hash provenance; missing values are `not_reported`, and no freshness, eligibility, or rights judgment is inferred. Fixed routes declare `financial_authority: none` and `carrier_state: not_published`; `carrier_url` is forbidden in that state.

- Privacy: https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/privacy/
- Terms: https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/terms/
- Support: https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/support/

- [Task automations](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/automations/): native n8n funding, Cosmos NPA and sized BTC exit workflows, optional Slack/Telegram delivery, focused Cursor skills and a local sources.csv Power Query reader. Workflows import inactive; directory acceptance is separate.

## Quant and research agents

- [AI execution walkthrough](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/execution.html): browser-only synthetic simulation, private paper REST/MCP host and a separately gated customer-owned live connector. The simulation contacts no broker and records no customer analytics.
- [Execution installation and scope](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/execution-setup.md): source-pinned setup, account controls, exact-order receipts, STOP and reconciliation. The live connector is an integration candidate; current public evidence does not qualify live execution.
- [Execution capability catalog](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/execution.json): machine-readable scopes and a dated source-gate observation. Public research MCP endpoints cannot execute orders.
- [Integration pilot scorecard](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/pilot-scorecard.md): a 14-day protocol for independent first use, repeat use and paid continuation; targets are not measured traction.

- [Product connection catalog](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/connections.json): direct LiquiLens, Seiche and Undertow MCP endpoints, initial coverage/health/access tools, and dated inventory checks.
- [MCP connection guide](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/CONNECT.md): portable and VS Code settings plus a bounded three-product API example. Public research tools have no execution authority; subscriber entitlements remain separate.

[Native framework tools and cited quant datasets](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/) connect Seiche, LiquiLens and Undertow. Source-pinned agent release 1.0.0 adds compact queries, a three-product review and repeat-call revisions. See [the source guide](https://github.com/beepboop2025/financial-evidence-skills/tree/agent-v1.0.0/integrations/agents). These are integration recipes, not evidence of external adoption.

- [API client kit](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/api/): Postman, Bruno, OpenAPI and HTTP clients; twelve bounded requests across seven datasets.
- [Platform evaluation](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/partners/): institutional evaluation brief, rights boundaries and a proposed analyst pilot.

## Durable research workflows

[Financial Evidence Runtime](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/runtime.html) supplies bounded local scheduling, fixed research policies, idempotency, retained source clocks, private MCP and backup recovery across LiquiLens, Seiche and Undertow. It grants no order permission. Internal checks are not external adoption.

## Current system interfaces

[System interface catalog](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/system.json) separates the public three-tool router 0.1.7, eight-tool hosted Research Desk 1.1.3, six-tool local Runtime contract 1.0.0 (package 0.1.7), Runtime Operations 1.0.3 and the private authenticated paper host. [Choose an interface](https://liquilens.in/agents/infrastructure/). Public MCP endpoints retain their read-only authority; local scheduling and paper-host installation require the operator-controlled setup described by their guides.

## Start a recurring task

[Three audience workflows](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/WORKFLOWS.md) cover a cited USD funding query for developers, the new institution monitor for treasury and bank-risk teams, and a funding-and-exit review for traders and researchers. [Machine-readable calls and repeat-use criteria](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/agents/workflows.json). Interface checks dated 9 October 2026; source freshness remains per observation. No automatic enrollment, scheduling or trading authority.
